name: Zain Catering Services - Complete Automation (All Modules)

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO clients (name, phone, whatsapp_number, email, address)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, email = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.email, clients.email)
RETURNING id;
UPDATE clients SET last_order_at = now() WHERE id = $1;
SELECT id, client_id, event_date, guest_count FROM orders WHERE order_ref = $1;
UPDATE orders SET status = 'confirmed', confirmed_at = now() WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id, order_ref, client_id, event_date, guest_count;

INSERT INTO invoices (order_id, invoice_number, subtotal, total, paid_amount, status)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO UPDATE SET
  subtotal = EXCLUDED.subtotal,
  total = EXCLUDED.total,
  paid_amount = EXCLUDED.paid_amount,
  status = EXCLUDED.status
RETURNING id, invoice_number, order_id;
INSERT INTO payments (invoice_id, amount, method, paid_at, is_promise) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, now(), false);

UPDATE clients SET email = COALESCE(NULLIF($2, ''), email) WHERE id = (SELECT client_id FROM orders WHERE id = $1); SELECT o.order_ref, o.event_date, o.guest_count, o.venue_address, o.sound_system, c.name AS client_name, c.phone AS client_phone, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.email, ''), $2) AS client_email, i.id AS invoice_id, i.invoice_number, i.total, i.paid_amount, i.balance, i.status, i.issued_at FROM orders o JOIN clients c ON c.id = o.client_id JOIN invoices i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.id = $1;

parameters.query: SELECT id, paid_amount, total FROM invoices WHERE invoice_number = $1;
INSERT INTO payments (invoice_id, amount, is_promise, promised_amount, promised_date, promise_status) VALUES ($1, 0, true, $2, $3, 'pending');
INSERT INTO payments (invoice_id, amount, method, paid_at, is_promise) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, now(), false);
UPDATE invoices SET paid_amount = paid_amount + $1, status = CASE WHEN (paid_amount + $1) >= total THEN 'paid' WHEN (paid_amount + $1) > 0 THEN 'partial' ELSE 'unpaid' END WHERE id = $2;

SELECT i.id, i.invoice_number, i.total, i.paid_amount, i.balance, i.status, c.name AS client_name, c.email AS client_email, o.order_ref FROM invoices i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id JOIN clients c ON c.id = o.client_id WHERE i.id = $1;
